page.overview:
What is Atlas, Rise!?

Atlas, Rise! is the second song from Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct, written by Lars Ulrich and James Hetfield. It made it's world debut on Halloween, 2016, by being available for streaming on Metallica's website as well as online radio stations and local [http://web.archive.org/web/20161122074047/https://metallica.com/blog/434150/metallica-mask-retailers-list independent record stores].

The song takes inspiration from the Greek myth of Atlas, the Titan who is forced to hold up the sky. The song talks about heavy burdens, suffering that we bring upon ourselves, the fight against huge responsibilities, and the desire to "rise" above everything. It makes us think about whether we are heroes or just being weighed down by the world's problems and drama.

Bitterness and burden Curses rest on thee Solitaire and sorrow All Eternity

Save the Earth and claim perfection Deem the mass and blame rejection Hold the pose, reign perception Grudges break your back
